svg.title: Wireframe 09: Canvas of an optimization model (Table and Diagram views)
svg.desc: The Canvas screen of a plan (an optimization model, spec 1 variables, objective and constraints), with the product mix of spec 2 entered. Top bar: project name, save state, undo, redo and Run; there is no experiment picker, since an optimization model has none. A switch chooses the Table view or the Diagram view of the same model. The Table view, on the left, has Decisions (name, kind, lower and upper bound, Remove), the Goal (maximize or minimize and one coefficient per decision, read back as a sentence) and Limits (name, one coefficient per decision, at most, at least or exactly, and the limit), each with an Add button; every field is one set_path or remove_path edit, and the service's issues show under the field their path names. The Diagram view, drawn on the right as it appears when chosen, shows each decision as a card on the left and the goal and each limit as a card on the right, with a line from a decision to each card that uses it, labelled with its coefficient. The problems list is under the views.
svg.text: Plan: decisions, a goal and limits
A field changes the model when committed: one set_path, or remove_path when emptied
Diagram view (the same model, when chosen)
Decisions on the left; the goal and each limit on the right.
A line joins a decision to each card that uses it, labelled
with its coefficient. Cards are placed automatically; nothing
about the layout is stored. Choosing a card opens its row in
the Table view. Network-shaped plans wait for the indexed layout.
Issues from POST validate, shown as the service wrote them (code, message, path); choosing one opens the Table view at its field.
